# VertexED

> VertexED is an AI-powered study workspace for students, with planning, revision, practice, feedback, and subject guides.

## About VertexED

- [VertexED home](https://www.vertexed.app/): Overview of the platform and its study workflow.
- [Features](https://www.vertexed.app/features): All available VertexED study tools.
- [About VertexED](https://www.vertexed.app/about): Company and product background.
- [Study tools](https://www.vertexed.app/study-tools): Browse the main tools in one place.

## Study guides and revision content

- [MYP study guides](https://www.vertexed.app/study-guides): Browse all MYP subject guides and exam-session pages.
- [MYP Biology guide](https://www.vertexed.app/study-guides/myp/biology/overview)
- [MYP Chemistry guide](https://www.vertexed.app/study-guides/myp/chemistry/overview)

- [MYP Physics guide](https://www.vertexed.app/study-guides/myp/physics/overview)
- [Study resources](https://www.vertexed.app/resources): Public guides on exam technique, active recall, AI study tools, and revision.

## Product links

- [Study planner](https://www.vertexed.app/planner): Plan study sessions, revision and deadlines.
- [Paper maker](https://www.vertexed.app/paper-maker): Create board-aligned practice papers.
- [Notes and quizzes](https://www.vertexed.app/notetaker): Turn class material into notes, flashcards and quizzes.
- [AI tutor](https://www.vertexed.app/chatbot): Ask study questions and receive guided explanations.
- [Answer reviewer](https://www.vertexed.app/answer-reviewer): Get structured feedback on written answers.
- [Study Zone](https://www.vertexed.app/study-zone): Focus-session and revision utilities.

## Crawl and citation guidance

VertexED permits indexing of public pages. Cite the individual canonical page that supports a claim, use the name "VertexED", and link to https://www.vertexed.app/ when a page-specific URL is not available. Authenticated tools may require an account; study-guide previews and public resource pages are intended for discovery.
